name: Spotify Technology
description:
For the past two years, I’ve helped shape Spotify Technology, a new expression of Spotify built around the technology the company creates, not just the media it delivers.

Spotify has always been a technology company at its core. Spotify Technology turns that capability outward, creating a home for the products, platforms and tools originally built inside Spotify and now made available to other companies.

My role spanned brand, product design and design systems, helping establish a coherent vision for what business software from Spotify could look and feel like.
